data.narrative:
HEO Robotics is a Series A-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by William Crowe and Hiranya Jayakody that has raised $10.1M to date. The valuation universe comprises 6 public Space & Aerospace peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private comparables including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE.

Of three triangulation methods tested, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method uses the $10.1M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of progression from Series A to subsequent stages, yielding an implied valuation of $20.2M. Peer-Median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within a narrow filter (0 same-stage, 2 adjacent-stage identified, below the 3-datapoint threshold). Public-Comp anchoring could not be executed because target revenue is not on file, a common limitation for private companies; the Space & Aerospace public median P/S multiple stands at 27.4x across the 5-ticker set, but cannot be meaningfully applied without revenue data.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $17M to $23M, with a median of $20.2M. This range reflects sensitivity bounds around the single applicable method rather than true triangulation. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue or margin visibility, lack of comparable Series A Space & Aerospace transactions, and dependence on stage-based step-up assumptions. Additional revenue disclosure would enable public-comp cross-validation.
